titulo_ja: ままに と ずじまい (2)

はいた.es: (forma た de はく) puse (zapatos, pantalones)

しまった.es: lo hizo sin querer; se acabó del todo
しまった.en: He did it unintentionally; it's all over.

texto: Indica que un estado continúa sin cambio: verbo en forma た o ない + **まま**, sustantivo + **のまま**, o adjetivo + **まま**. Example: **くつ を はいた まま、 ねて しまいました** (I slept with my shoes on).
Expresses its action according to an instruction, desire or state: noun + **のままに** / verb + **ままに**. **こころ の ままに いきる** means to live by your own wishes. It is common in written style.

filas: verbo en た/ない + まま
はいた まま / しらない まま
こころ の ままに

intro: Now, how to say that something stays the same as it was, without changing. It is very useful to describe how someone does something, or a state that is not corrected.
